2607.02121.title: Behind the Refusal: Determining Guardrail Activation via Behavioral Monitoring
2607.02121.paper_summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic systems become integrated into real-world applications, ensuring their safety and security is critical. Guardrail systems that detect and block malicious instructions sent to and from an LLM are an essential component of AI security. However, researchers conducting black-box adversarial emulation against production AI systems often struggle to determine whether a guardrail block or an LLM rejection has occurred. This distinction is important because the techniques used to bypass guardrails can differ substantially from those used to bypass LLM safety alignment, and has a material impact on attack technique selection and optimization. We propose the first black-box guardrail reconnaissance methodology, which detects the presence of a guardrail within a target AI system through behavioral monitoring of HTTP, lexical, and timing signals, assuming only black-box access and zero prior knowledge of the guardrail or AI system. Experiments demonstrate that our approach detects guardrail presence with 100% accuracy, with statistically significant behavioral separation between benign and malicious interactions (q < 0.001). Our approach further identifies the content categories a guardrail is designed to block, and distinguishes guardrail blocks from LLM rejection on unseen prompts with an average F1 score of 98%.
2607.02121.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）和代理系統逐漸融入現實世界應用，確保它們的安全性和可靠性變得至關重要。檢測並阻止發送到和從LLM發送的惡意指令的護欄系統是AI安全的重要組成部分。然而，對生產AI系統進行黑箱對抗模擬的研究人員，經常難以確定是發生了護欄阻擋還是LLM拒絕。這一區別很重要，因為繞過護欄的技術可能與繞過LLM安全對齊的技術有很大不同，並對攻擊技術的選擇和優化產生實質影響。我們提出了首個黑箱護欄偵察方法，通過對HTTP、詞彙和時間信號的行為監測來檢測目標AI系統中護欄的存在，假設僅有黑箱訪問和對護欄或AI系統沒有先前的知識。實驗表明，我們的方法以100%的準確率檢測到護欄的存在，並在良性和惡意互動之間顯示出統計上顯著的行為分離（q < 0.001）。我們的方法進一步識別護欄設計用來阻擋的內容類別，並在未見的提示上以98%的平均F1分數區分護欄阻擋和LLM拒絕。
